method: host GDB breakpoint at the PE opengl32 glDrawElements thunk while Proton/Mesa was rendering the live game

dispatch.dispatch_kind: indirect call through the engine's own table, not an import slot
dispatch.note: the thunk address is process-specific; the table RVA and call site are build-specific

hand_draw.layout_note: positions are the first three floats and normals the next three; attribute byte offsets were measured, while the current program and uniform values were not captured reliably

experiments.name: suppress_count
experiments.change: set the hand draw count from 1188 to 0
experiments.result: the entire first-person arm disappeared while the world continued rendering

experiments.name: restore_count
experiments.change: removed the suppression breakpoint and restored normal drawing

experiments.name: cube_count_36
experiments.change: replaced the first eight 72-byte vertex records and first 36 indices with a cube, and set count to 36
experiments.result: the arm disappeared and only a small fragment was visible; the cube inherited one vertex's weights and was not placed at a usable hand pivot

experiments.name: stale_count_1188
experiments.change: replaced the first records but left count at 1188 before the capture deadline
experiments.result: the arm visibly stretched into large triangles, proving the live draw consumed the substituted buffer

experiments.name: outward_winding_retest
experiments.change: reversed all cube triangles to face outward and re-ran the substitution
experiments.result: the same small fragment remained; back-face culling is not the cause, so placement or the inherited vertex attributes are the remaining issue

restoration: the original VBO and IBO were written back at the hand draw and a screenshot confirmed the original arm returned
limitations: the production dispatch-table hook is not yet implemented
current program, texture bindings and bone_transforms were not captured reliably
the 16-bone runtime bake is complete but is not yet driven by the game draw path
the live substitution is a debugger proof, not a shipped mod path
